reviewer_role: Independent pre-implementation gold author, now performing a post-result reporting audit
assessment_scope: The preserved finite first-result report agrees with the frozen expectations and keeps representation agreement, positive-goal acquisition, and downstream measurement separate. This is not a completion verdict for Arabic reading or downstream semantics.

review_method.recomputation: Used Python standard-library JSON, hashes, arithmetic, and string/byte indexing on preserved artifacts. Did not import or run the evaluator, acquisition engine, or inference engine. A preceding read-only audit call completed the per-row checks listed below before detecting separate current-working-tree hash differences.
review_method.provenance_checks: Gold digest, first-result digest, manifest digest, matrix-before-implementation git ancestry, and stored before/after snapshot equality were checked.
review_method.independence_limit: Procedural separation between model agents, not an external human blind study. Post-result access is exposed review. Recorded native-verification claims were inspected but the native engine was deliberately not rerun.

execution_provenance.current_working_tree_interpretation: These are post-result working-tree observations, not modifications made by this reviewer. The current tree must not be presented as the exact measured implementation freeze. The preserved first-result file and its recorded snapshots remain unchanged.

findings.claim: All 72 statuses match; 37/37 hand-derived complete cell arrays and 7/7 declared reasons match. No false acquisition license was observed against the 23 expected noncomplete rows.
findings.limit: The 12 acquired condition rows have status expectations but no independent complete-cell arrays; native replay is a separate implementation agreement check.

findings.claim: The report retains both 49/49 expected-complete acquisition and 32/47 positive-goal acquisition. Orthography positive coverage is 10/18, with eight correctly deferred positive goals remaining misses.
findings.limit: Do not present the field named positive_acquisition_coverage as overall positive-goal coverage. Its denominator is expected ACQUIRED rows, including acquired negative downstream controls.

findings.claim: Orthography/acquisition SUCCESS=16 consists of ten positive acquisitions and six correct negative boundary outcomes.
findings.limit: 16/24 is not positive acquisition coverage; the latter is 10/18. The six negative outcomes must not inflate language-understanding success.

findings.claim: All 48 downstream measurements are UNMEASURED. All 29 positive downstream goals are coverage MISS, and the 19 negative goals remain UNMEASURED rather than receiving success credit.
findings.limit: Person and nominal-syntax goals currently lack exact executable goal contracts. A word-reader result alone does not discharge those authored goals.

findings.claim: All 16 conditional results are UNKNOWN/OUTSIDE_FRAGMENT, with native_checked=false and verified=false; none receives downstream SUCCESS. Five positive conditional goals are MISS.
findings.limit: This does not measure semantic handling of quotation, negation, changed subjects, or hidden subjects. It observes abstention outside the installed fragment.

findings.claim: Stored exact source text, byte/code-point intervals, word boundaries, cell domains, reader text, and complete-word shape handoff bindings passed independent artifact checks for all 72 rows.
findings.limit: Source-preserving representation remains distinct from acoustic truth, attestation, grammar, reference, and world truth.

findings.claim: The verified_exact count of 49 agrees with all expectations declared for those rows.
findings.limit: It must not be described as 49 independently hand-derived exact-cell checks; that count is 37.

findings.claim: The matrix records zero resource-exhaustion outcomes.
findings.limit: This matrix contains no runtime type or resource-bound invocations. Resource, transport, tampering, and source-withdrawal coverage must be reported from separate suites, not inferred from zero occurrences here.

findings.claim: O16 is representation-ACQUIRED while its sound-shape handoff is SHAPE_REJECTED, and the report preserves that distinction.
findings.limit: Acquisition completeness is not sound-shape acceptance or lexical attestation.

publication_wording: Finite first execution: 72/72 representation expectations matched, including 37/37 independent complete-cell arrays and 7/7 declared reasons, with zero observed false acquisition licenses. All 16 conditional probes were outside the installed fragment.
